title: Riot Squad Connex Prefilled Pod Vape Kit
description: The Riot Connex is a revolutionary vape kit designed for simplicity, sustainability, and immense satisfaction. With its rechargeable USB Type-C battery (cable not included) and convenient on/off switch for extra security, the Connex kit stands out as an ideal choice for both newcomers to vaping and those seeking a hassle-free and eco-friendly alternative to disposable vapes. Each kit comes with two 2ml pods, pre-filled with Riot Squad's finest e-liquid flavours developed in their UK lab, delivering up to 1200 puffs per kit. The Connex doesn't just simplify vaping with its clip-and-vape mechanism; it also heralds a new wave in environmental responsibility. Once you've enjoyed the rich and diverse flavours, the empty pods can be easily recycled with household plastics, underlining Riot Squad’s commitment to reducing vaping's carbon footprint. The custom mesh coil in each pod ensures every puff is bursting with flavour, providing a smooth mouth-to-lung experience that closely mimics traditional smoking. The choice of 13 mouth-watering flavours means there's a taste for every palate, from fruity varieties to classic tobacco, menthol, and soda options, all in a super-satisfying 10mg or 20mg Nicotine Salt formulation for the smoothest throat hit and near-instant relief from nicotine cravings. Embrace the future of vaping with the Riot Connex kit: a perfect blend of convenience, performance, and sustainability. This is more than just a vape kit; it's a seismic departure from single-use disposables and a welcome step towards a cleaner planet. Features: USB Type-C Rechargeable Battery: Enjoy the convenience of recharging with a modern USB Type-C connection. Safety On/Off Switch: Added security with an easy-to-use on/off switch to prevent accidental activation. 2ml Premium Flavoured Capsules: Each capsule is pre-filled with 2ml of Riot’s finest, gourmet flavours, crafted in their UK laboratory for unparalleled satisfaction. Custom Mesh Coil Technology: Experience enhanced flavour and vapour production with Riot’s custom-designed mesh coils. Eco-Friendly Capsule Recycling: Once finished, capsules can be recycled with your regular household plastics. User-Friendly Design: As simple as disposables — unwrap the battery and capsule, switch on, connect, and vape away. Up to 1200 Puffs: Delivers approximately 1200 puffs per kit, ensuring a long-lasting vaping experience (based on two 600-puff detachable pods). Wide Range of Flavours: Indulge in a diverse selection of mouth-watering flavours, there's something for every palate. Constructed from Recycled Materials: Emphasizing Riot’s eco-friendly initiative, the device is made using recycled plastics. Commitment to Carbon Negativity: Every Riot product contributes to a carbon-negative footprint. Available in 10mg or 20mg Please note: Charging cable is not supplied. A USB-C cable can be purchased separately. Shop Riot Connex Refill Pods
